segments.transcript: I think the highest we can go is maybe $1,000.
I want to say yes, but I made a promise to myself. I got to stop doing free work.
I mean, there's part of me that feels like we should be allocating all of our resources to these dogs.
It just feels out of alignment with the mission of what we're trying to do.
Okay. Does anybody in your organization get paid? We have one executive director. And is it out of alignment for your executive director to get paid?
No. Why do you feel like it's okay for them to get paid? / Because they put in so much time and labor into saving these animals. / Okay.
So you don't think I put time and labor into what I do?
I value things I pay for, and generally I don't value things I don't pay for,
Even people who adopt animals pay for the adoption, no? Why don't you just give it away for free?
